insights.one_liner: Gowling WLG is an international Canadian-British law firm; its postings here are entry-level data roles in The Hague.

culture.text: A law firm with over 1,500 legal professionals worldwide; LinkedIn lists 3,631 employees, mostly lawyers and legal staff.
It says it rewards collaboration and team performance and pushes people to develop.
Its 2 open jobs here are entry-level data roles in The Hague.

open.text: Gowling WLG is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings need no Dutch, but they average about 200 LinkedIn applicants.
It says it encourages equity, diversity and inclusion and is recognised as a top employer.

growth.text: It was formed in 2016 by combining Canadian firm Gowlings with UK firm Wragge Lawrence Graham & Co.
Gowling WLG raised pay for newly qualified lawyers.

worth_knowing.text: Gowling WLG has a new CEO, who says you can be ultra-high-performing and nice.
